review_type: implementation self-check and measured CPU evidence; separate independent acceptance agent not invoked

integration.api: capture_hand_views(env, out, t, slots, kind, contact_identity) -> list[group_receipt]
integration.example:
from hand_views import capture_hand_views
hand_receipts = capture_hand_views(env, self.out, t, slots, kind, self.out / "native_contact_identity.json")
integration.placement: Invoke once per (kind,t), all selected slots together, after the parent nine-view capture and before any next physics/control step, while parent owns the same macro-post hold. No parent source edited here.
integration.contact_identity: Path to identity JSON or parsed native_hand_contact.v1 dict. Prefer current-run observer identity. CPU reference is native_smoke_04/native_contact_identity.json. All64 live PhysX link_paths/body_names must match exact sensors before capture.
prerequisites: camera update_period=0; PARTIAL_RENDERING or FULL_RENDERING; exactly one sensor row
meter-scaled USD stage and centered perspective optics; nonzero aperture offsets rejected
IsaacLab articulation PhysX simulation-view subspace root /, so native link positions are already world coordinates
parent holds physical time synchronously; no concurrent physics/control task
integration.returns: One receipt per slot: state JSON path/SHA and twelve original PNG paths/SHAs. Separate final receipts.json includes visibility restoration and final native invariant. Exclusive output creation prevents accidental overwrite.
integration.runtime_output: out/hand_views/{kind}/step_{t:04d}/; per-slot state.json and 12 raw PNGs; all64 before/final NPZ plus after NPZ for each image; full exact identity mapping JSON. Existing out/multiview nine-view output is retained.
integration.parent_oracle: Reads matching parent groupstate and original native snapshot if present; checks snapshot SHA and all64 q/qd/root/root_vel bytes plus selected controlled q/qd. Missing parent group remains pending. cell_001.npz/macropost oracle binding remains explicitly pending_parent_integration.
integration.time: Records measured env.sim.current_time and current_time_step_index alongside logical (t+1)*step_dt. Camera.update(0, force_recompute=True) refreshes sensors without adding virtual elapsed time. Sensor frame must increment exactly once.

implemented_invariants: Exactly four arms x three hand-relative views per slot, no crop, resize, montage or RGB value rescaling.

Hand sensors map by exact PhysX rigidpath AND body_name to get_link_transforms tensor indices; all64 hand link inventory equality rejects drops, unmatched paths, duplicate names/sensors and wrong environment ordering.
Each F hand has native left/right_hand_base anchor; each U hand has wrist_3_link anchor. Actual native XYZW quaternion rotates opposing above/below and cross-above local camera directions.
AABB center of actual hand-link world positions is camera target. No old controlled-q replay or environment-origin double addition.

Analytical distance interval fits .06m link-center spheres plus .05m clearance to left/right/top/bottom/near/far planes, including impossible-far-plane rejection; pose and framing are checked again from USD after render.
Actual USD camera-to-world row matrix, focal/aperture optics, K with SDK cross-check, clipping range, per-sphere plane margins and raw PNG/pixel hashes accompany each image.
Allfour-hand full native q/qd/root transforms/root velocities/link transforms/position targets included with every image state, selected hand positions and exact mapping included.
All64 detached native snapshots compared with identical dtype, shape and bytes around each render; signed-zero changes rejected. Physical time/index and origins included.

Only camera.set_world_poses_from_view, env.sim.render and camera.update are called to obtain views; USD visibility edits restored in finally. No physics step, reset, joint/root/target writes or physics state replay.
Native historical contact microstep peaks are not relabelled as macro camera states.

known stale SDK camera position not used as USD actual pose

cpu_evidence.negative_control_note: No intentional broken implementation was committed. Executed negative controls explicitly demonstrate center-only framing, radius omission, all64 sensor drop and byte-state mutations are rejected.

remaining_parent_validation: Development06 live get_link_transforms/link_paths/body_names agreement and all64 zero-drop exact mapping.
Live 12 PNGs per slot: inspect known native04 contacts and corrected .35rad-open hands, especially U_R thumb2/wrist3; do not infer new contact outcomes from CPU tests.
Read back actual live USD optics/pose/clips, raw PNG dimensions/SHA, measured simulation time, sensor refresh and all64 before/after bytes.
Run separate parent cell oracle to bind macro q/qd and actual hold time; retain nine overview views and identify microstep-vs-macro scope.
Only parent freezes fresh128x4x960 acceptance after development evidence; no fresh acceptance or new policy result is claimed here.
limitations: Link-center spheres are a conservative framing proxy, not certified containment of all mesh vertices.
Three views do not certify visibility of every finger surface or absence of occlusion.
The capture path was not executed here: actual camera/renderer, exact live PhysX mapping and physical-state invariance still require parent GPU validation.
Stage visibility is restored; the shared camera remains at the last hand view. Each parent view already sets its camera pose before rendering.
No third-party agent, GPU/Isaac process, production source mutation or SEALED artifact mutation was performed.
